_format: Copy to <TRADINGAGENTS_WEBUI_HOME>/cost-prices.json (default ~/.tradingagents/webui/cost-prices.json). models: { "<model id exactly as the run saved it, e.g. the quick/deep model name>": { "input_per_million": "<price per 1M input tokens>", "output_per_million": "<price per 1M output tokens>", "currency": "USD" } }. Prices are per million tokens, as strings or numbers; currency defaults to USD. A model that is not listed shows 价格未知. Keys other than models are ignored. This template ships empty on purpose: no provider price is guessed.
